description:
helpcenter_create_redirect for up to 200 redirects in one call, saved in order (a later one for the same 'from' wins). A page of helpcenter_get_import_redirect_map can be passed as it is.

Works once the user has claimed the help center, verified their email address and activated a plan; until then it answers capability_locked with the user's next step (helpcenter_get_help_center shows it too).

A failed item never fails the batch: the result lists each item's outcome, in order — created, updated, or error with the code helpcenter_create_redirect would have answered. Read meta.failed, fix or drop the failed items, and send only those again; resending the whole batch is harmless too (an existing 'from' is re-pointed, never duplicated).

Args:
  - redirects ({ from, to }[], required): 1 to 200.

Returns: { results: [ { index, status: "created" | "updated" | "error", redirect?, error? } ], meta: { total, created, updated, failed } }.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

redirects.description: 1 to 200 redirects, saved in order (a later one for the same from wins). A page of helpcenter_get_import_redirect_map can be passed as it is.

from.description: A path of the old help center, like '/hc/en-us/articles/360001-Billing': no scheme or host, no query or fragment, not the home page.

to.description: Where it goes: a page of THIS help center, as a path like '/en/content/billing' (an agent key may not redirect to another site).

name: helpcenter_bulk_create_redirects
title: Create Redirects in Bulk
